summary.text: Sue Vandecasteele is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 25 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.

paragraphs.text: Susan Vandecasteele was born in Salem, New Hampshire, and graduated from Salem High School in 1986.
Her career experience includes working in automotive customer service and management.
Ballotpedia lists Vandecasteele's tenure in the New Hampshire House of Representatives as beginning in 2020.
